title: The Impact of Choosing a Righteous Spouse on the Offspring

text_simplified: The first pillar of tarbiyah is choosing a righteous wife known for uprightness, righteousness, and piety before the children arrive, because she helps in raising them, and even if she does not help, she will not harm them. For this reason the Prophet ﷺ urged marrying a woman of religion. A righteous wife is among the greatest causes of happiness in this world, due to her sincerity, truthfulness, trustworthiness, loyalty, preserving wealth, protecting honor, and good tarbiyah. Her righteousness usually reflects on the children because of her close contact with them and her care for them.
